adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, `rss.items.each` directly calls `TopicEmbed.import(...)` with no per-item error handling. `TopicEmbed.import` can raise (e.g., `PostCreator#create`/DB errors inside the transaction), and any exception would break out of the loop and abort the job, preventing remaining feed items from being processed in that poll cycle. With `sidekiq_options retry: false`, it also won’t be retried automatically, amplifying the impact.
